business_problem: CBC Tech's service assurance operation was spread across siloed systems for incidents, knowledge, inventory, and customer data, making it hard to deliver consistent omnichannel support or give staff and leaders real-time visibility into what customers needed.
solution_summary: CBC Tech began its transformation by deploying the ServiceNow AI Platform with Telecommunications Service Management, using one internal portal for customer support, customer success, and engineering teams. Frontline agents now have immediate access to customer and technical data so they can triage incidents and hand them to the right experts without switching systems. The same portal also acts as the knowledge platform, with hierarchical storage, conversational search, and customizable reports that give agents and leaders a live picture of issue volume, status, and trends. Service Bridge is the next layer in the design, linking CBC Tech more directly to large enterprise customers that already use ServiceNow so onboarding and multi-instance workflows become easier to coordinate. With portal and knowledge workflows unified, CBC Tech has created a single service-assurance ecosystem that treats every incident, report, and future self-service task as part of one digital customer experience.

solution_components.name: Telecommunications Service Management
solution_components.role: Provides the unified incident and service-assurance workflow foundation for CBC Tech.

solution_components.name: Knowledge base
solution_components.role: Stores and organizes support knowledge so agents can retrieve relevant answers quickly.

solution_components.name: Service Bridge
solution_components.role: Extends service workflows into customer ServiceNow environments for closer collaboration.

data_flow: Customer incidents enter a unified ServiceNow portal used by support, success, and engineering teams. Telecommunications Service Management routes the work, the knowledge base provides searchable resolution context, and Service Bridge is used to connect service workflows more directly with large enterprise customers on their own ServiceNow estates.
business_outcome: CBC Tech now supports 100% of customers on ServiceNow, reached 97% customer satisfaction and a net promoter score of 72, improved customer effort scores to 90%, and created a foundation for self-service portals and multi-instance collaboration with major customers.
architecture_clues: CBC Tech uses one internal portal across customer support, customer success, and engineering teams.
The knowledge base is structured hierarchically for nested categorization and search.
Service Bridge is intended to support multi-instance workflows with Fortune 500 customers already using ServiceNow.

A single internal ServiceNow portal was first launched for all CBC Tech customer support, customer success, and engineering teams to manage and respond to incoming customer incidents.
Access to the ServiceNow knowledge base has been a game changer.
ServiceNow Service Bridge promises to enable CBC Tech to forge even closer relationships with key customers.
Its latest Net Promoter Score has increased to 72; Customer satisfaction stands at a near perfect 97%.
